experiment: C6-A/B/C identifiability and observation information, not model superiority
latent_units: effective-force units: dX=(1.5-.15X-U)dt+sigma*dW; formerly1.5*U absorbed into U,Y; V=U+noise is calibrated in these units
B: direct, effective U=Y, no internal transfer state
C: two identical stages kappa/2, total mean lag kappa
D: time-varying first-order: tau_pre=kappa/(1-.75/e), switches to tau_pre/4 at onset+tau_pre; total mean lag kappa
classification: predeclared model library, Gaussian X innovation likelihood, proper half-normal amplitude marginal, onset and scale marginalized; no sample mechanism labels used in fitting
nuisance_prior: amplitude prior scale chosen from [.5,1,2,4] by pooled UNLABELLED training-X mixture evidence; uniform class prior, log-grid scale prior, uniform onset grid
uncertainty: argmax accuracy plus max-posterior<.8 abstention and95% class credible-set size; abstention is finite-data uncertainty, not proof of structural impossibility
passive: unknown step source at10, amplitude randomized1.125..1.875, inference not given onset/amplitude/scale
auxiliary: main test X+V_U at3 noise levels; physical-equivalence pair also X+V_Y to test sensor placement

equivalence_controls.representation: first-order hidden-state and reduced form are same physical input-output model, including registered interventions
equivalence_controls.causal: filtered step source versus direct exponentially-smooth source, identical passive X AND effective U, different Y; do(Y=I) overrides both source generators

interventions: randomized27 protocols: source amplitudes1/1.5/2, starts7/10/13, durations.5/2/4; same protocol across paired candidate true mechanisms
intervention_comparison: same active X, input assignment hidden versus known; hidden arm marginalizes all27 randomized protocols, avoiding wrong step-only baseline
primary_family: 8 paired information gains: main V_U three levels; causal-equivalence V_Y three levels; main intervention known-vs-hidden; binary causal intervention known-vs-hidden
correction: 99.375% paired stratified-cluster CI, Bonferroni8; both cohorts positive
classification_feasibility: descriptive absolute balanced accuracy>=70%, with uncertainty/condition limits; no forced superiority over equivalent laws
warnings: M3 and matched generic GLR unchanged algorithm, X only in ALL arms; independent5% whole-trajectory calibration; B does not change detector while adding classification sensor; intervention response alarms are not unexpected-fault advance warnings
